name: Highlands 6

alpha.desc: The alpha view highlights the front of the large multi-wing residence set on a raised desert terrain pad, with a curved driveway approaching from the right side and looping around the front of the structure|Multiple steep multi-pitch roof sections are visible across the main residence, and the front entry area is flanked by scattered conifer trees|The paved driveway connects from a road junction at the upper right of the parcel and provides the primary vehicle approach to the front of the structure|Open desert terrain surrounds the developed pad on all sides, providing clear sightlines to the structure from the approach road.

bravo.desc: The bravo view shows the property from the right side, revealing the tennis court and putting green situated to the left-rear of the residence, along with the curved driveway that arcs around the north side of the structure|The right side of the residence presents multiple roof forms at varying heights with no visible balconies or exterior staircases on this elevation|The driveway curves along the right perimeter of the landscaped pad, offering vehicle access around the structure to the rear|The terrain on the right side slopes away from the pad into open desert scrubland.

charlie.desc: The charlie view shows the rear of the property, where the putting green and a swimming pool are visible directly behind the residence|The rear elevation of the residence includes multiple roof peaks and a patio area adjacent to the pool|Access from the rear is limited to foot movement across the landscaped area, as the driveway does not extend around to the rear of the structure|The road visible in the lower left of this view is a public roadway exterior to the parcel boundary.

delta.desc: The delta view shows the left side of the property, with the curved driveway clearly visible as it sweeps around the left and front of the residence|A large flat-roofed white structure, consistent with a garage or detached structure, is visible on the left side of the main residence|The putting green and pool are visible to the right rear, and the tennis court is positioned further to the rear-left of the main structure|The left side of the property transitions directly to open desert terrain with no fencing or barriers visible along this perimeter.

considerations: The residence is accessed by a single curved private driveway that connects to the public road at one entry point, creating a long-approach, single-access condition. The driveway loops around the front and portions of the sides of the structure, allowing apparatus to circle for turnaround. The developed pad is elevated slightly above the surrounding desert terrain, and the approach road has moderate curvature. Rear access to the structure requires on-foot movement across the landscaped area, as the paved driveway does not extend around the back of the residence.
clarifications: Does the driveway gate or entry point have any access control device such as a keypad, callbox, or intercom that could delay responder entry? Is the large detached structure on the left side of the residence a garage, and if so, how many vehicle bays does it contain? Are there any locked pedestrian gates between the driveway and the rear yard or pool area? What is the surface material of the driveway — is it rated for heavy apparatus weight? Is there a secondary or emergency access road connecting the property to any adjacent road other than the primary driveway entry?
